name: hyperstreet
title: hyperstreet
blurb: a looping neon street where every account active on atproto right now is a building carrying a sword forged from its DID. everything is a plugin, and you can walk it on the web, in cardboard VR, from an in-page terminal, or with a node CLI. @kaidav.is asked for a hyperscale cyberpunk metaverse with cool swords.
